records.title: A Main Haunt for the A Site entry
records.description: Stand against the wall behind the tall blue utility box in A Main. Look up at the box's upper front panel beneath the bent yellow conduit and match the crosshair offset in the clip. Throw Haunt from that corner to scan A Site, then move with the scan. The linked POV shows the exact stance and release.

records.title: B Nest Haunt for B Site without Lane
records.description: Stand in the B Nest corner beside the gray structure with the wooden planter above it. Look upward at the wooden frame and match its lower-right edge reference shown in the clip before throwing Haunt toward B Site. Use the scan for the B entry. This throw does not scan Lane; clear Lane separately.

records.title: B Site Haunt counterscan from wooden cover
records.description: On B defense, tuck behind the tall wooden cover on B Site. Aim upward through the gap beside the blue connecting pipe, matching the wall reference shown in the clip, then throw Haunt over the cover. Use this counterscan when opponents pressure B; the source demonstrates the scan and an enemy spotted in B.

records.title: B Main Haunt from the B Site cover notch
records.description: Move into the notch between the low gray cube and the taller dark-faced cover on B Site. Turn toward B Main and look up at the wooden cap on the pipe-support column. Match the edge reference in the clip and throw Haunt over the structure to scan B Main. Stay behind site cover while the scan reveals the approach.
